scientific_integrity: The directly refined published planar convex-geometric Hölder theorem has primary MSC 52A40. An analytic differentiated-integral and dominated-convergence proof determines the exact coefficient and sign. Finite numerical quadrature is corroborative. Related fixed-perimeter inequalities and general Hausdorff regularity are distinguished, and uncertain unindexed priority remains possible.
scientific_limitations: The negative-power monotonicity counterexample is restricted to sufficiently thin, nested, centrally symmetric ellipses; no unique interior minimizer is proved. The exact cusp coefficient is path-specific. The universal Hölder exponent p+1 has already appeared in the literature and is not claimed as new.
title: Exact thin-ellipse cusp and the sharp inclusion-monotonicity threshold for radial weighted perimeter
